boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Documented Saint John’s customs, annual gatherings and campus symbols rooted in the Johnnie community.

cards.title: Tap a Maple at the Maple Syrup Festival
cards.subtitle: Saint John’s University · Collegeville, Minnesota
cards.notes: Join the end-of-season festival to see tree tapping and the syrup-making tradition that Saint John’s has maintained since the 1940s.
cards.short_summary: A spring celebration of Saint John’s long-running maple-sugaring work.
cards.evidence_claim: CSB+SJU identifies maple syruping at Saint John’s as a tradition since the 1940s and says the season ends with a festival featuring tree tapping.
cards.access_notes: Festival details and scheduling vary by year; use the university’s event information before visiting.

cards.title: Share a Hot Bread Night Study Break
cards.subtitle: Saint John’s University · Collegeville, Minnesota
cards.notes: Look for this residence-hall study break, where Johnnies gather with floor mates for freshly baked Johnnie Bread and toppings.
cards.short_summary: A floor-based bread-and-toppings break tied to Johnnie residence life.
cards.evidence_claim: CSB+SJU describes Hot Bread Night as a study break in which Johnnies enjoy freshly baked Johnnie Bread with their floor mates.
cards.access_notes: Offered through residence-life programming; availability depends on hall and academic-term scheduling.

cards.title: Gather for the Christmas Tree Lighting
cards.subtitle: Saint John’s University · Collegeville, Minnesota
cards.notes: Watch for the annual holiday-season gathering, with seasonal programming and hot chocolate when the campus tree is lit.
cards.short_summary: An annual Saint John’s holiday-season tree-lighting gathering.
cards.evidence_claim: CSB+SJU states that annual Christmas tree-lighting ceremonies at Saint John’s kick off the holiday season.
cards.access_notes: This is a seasonal annual event; confirm the current year’s date, location and attendance details through campus announcements.

cards.title: PrePEAR for Fruit at the Finish
cards.subtitle: CSB+SJU · Collegeville, Minnesota
cards.notes: Register or cheer at the spring triathlon, a campus tradition pairing swimming, biking and running with playful fruit-themed programming.
cards.short_summary: A springtime CSB+SJU triathlon with a deliberately fruity finish-line identity.
cards.evidence_claim: CSB+SJU calls Fruit at the Finish Triathlon a springtime tradition, and The Record reported its 27th annual event in 2026.
cards.access_notes: Participation format, route and registration are event-specific; check current Outdoor Leadership Center or campus-event information.

cards.title: Dress Up for the Holiday Dinner
cards.subtitle: Saint John’s University · Collegeville, Minnesota
cards.notes: Watch campus programming before break for the Thanksgiving or Christmas family-style dinner, including traditions such as turkey carving.
cards.short_summary: Pre-break holiday meals held in a family-style campus setting.
cards.evidence_claim: CSB+SJU says CSB and SJU host Thanksgiving and Christmas dinners before holiday breaks, with students dressing up for family-style feasts.
cards.access_notes: These are seasonal campus meals; confirm the current event’s eligibility, reservations and dining details.

cards.title: Come Back for Saint John’s Homecoming
cards.subtitle: Saint John’s University · Collegeville, Minnesota
cards.notes: Use the annual homecoming weekend to connect with the school’s alumni tradition, documented by the university archives back to an 1882 gathering.
cards.short_summary: A long-running campus-and-alumni return tradition with deep archival roots.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint John’s Libraries describes Homecoming as a longstanding tradition and traces an alumni-invited campus gathering to October 1882.
cards.access_notes: Homecoming dates and individual events change annually; consult the university’s current alumni and events listings.

cards.title: Learn the Johnnie Fight Song
cards.subtitle: Saint John’s University · Collegeville, Minnesota
cards.notes: Follow the official alumni song page to learn the Johnnie Fight Song and its repeated Saint John’s cheer before a campus spirit event.
cards.short_summary: Saint John’s official fight song and closing cheer.
cards.evidence_claim: The SJU Alumni site publishes the Johnnie Fight Song, including its Saint John’s cheer, as one of Saint John’s school songs.
cards.source_title: Saint John’s School Songs | SJU Alumni
cards.access_notes: The official page provides a downloadable version; performance context varies by campus event.

cards.title: Sing “High Above the Sagatagan”
cards.subtitle: Saint John’s University · Collegeville, Minnesota
cards.notes: Read the official Alma Mater lyrics, which open with Lake Sagatagan and the oak-and-pine setting central to Saint John’s identity.
cards.short_summary: The school song that names Sagatagan and the Collegeville landscape.
cards.evidence_claim: The SJU Alumni site publishes Saint John’s Alma Mater, whose opening line references Sagatagan and whose lyrics praise Saint John’s.
cards.source_title: Saint John’s School Songs | SJU Alumni
cards.access_notes: The official alumni page provides a downloadable version of the Alma Mater.

cards.title: Spot the Bell Banner on a Johnnie Ring
cards.subtitle: Saint John’s University · Collegeville, Minnesota
cards.notes: See the archival account of the ring introduced at Homecoming in 1997, designed around the Abbey Church bell banner rather than a class year.
cards.short_summary: A shared-ring tradition built around the Abbey Church bell banner.
cards.evidence_claim: An SJU Archives alumni-magazine record says a new Johnnie Ring was introduced at 1997 Homecoming and identifies the Abbey Church bell banner as its central symbol.
cards.source_title: 1997-12 SJU Alumni Magazine Volume 37 No. 1 Winter | SJU Archives
cards.access_notes: The archive documents the ring’s 1997 introduction; availability and current ordering options are not established by this source.

cards.title: Read the Johnnie Wall Stories
cards.subtitle: Alcuin Library · Saint John’s University
cards.notes: Visit the Alcuin Library display to read the stories of selected Johnnies, a Student Senate project created to pass on campus inspiration.
cards.short_summary: A Senate-created wall honoring Johnnies who inspire the next generation.
cards.evidence_claim: SJU Student Senate says the Johnnie Wall began in 2018, highlights selected Johnnies and is located in Alcuin Library by the Schu.
cards.source_title: The Johnnie Wall and Spotlight | SJU Student Senate
cards.access_notes: The page locates the wall in Alcuin Library; confirm building access and current display status before visiting.
